key_file_excerpts..github/workflows/gh-pages.yml:
name: gh-pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ["master"]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: "docs-gh-pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' || !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip docs]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout master
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: master
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "24"

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y pandoc
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install pyyaml
          npm install
      - name: Verify Documentating contract
        run: npm test

      - name: Build canonical Antora source tree
        run: |
          python3 tools/build_antora_site.py

      - name: Build site with Antora
        run: |
          npx antora antora-playbook.yml --fetch

      - name: Copy public site extras
        run: |
          if [ -f docs/CNAME ]; then
            cp docs/CNAME .site_build/CNAME
          fi

          if [ -d assets ]; then
            mkdir -p .site_build/assets
            cp -R assets/. .site_build/assets/
          fi

          if [ -d docs/quality-atlas ]; then
            mkdir -p .site_build/quality-atlas
            cp -R docs/quality-atlas/. .site_build/quality-atlas/
          fi

          if [ -d docs/qa-rc ]; then
            mkdir -p .site_build/qa-rc
            cp -R docs/qa-rc/. .site_build/qa-rc/
          fi

          touch .site_build/.nojekyll

      - name: Publish owner-facing site to gh-pages
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"

          workdir="$(mktemp -d)"

          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin gh-pages >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git fetch origin gh-pages:gh-pages
            git worktree add --force "$workdir" gh-pages
          else
            git worktree add --detach "$workdir"
            (
              cd "$workdir"
              git checkout --orphan gh-pages
            )
          fi

          find "$workdir" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.git' -exec rm -rf {} +
          cp -R .site_build/. "$workdir"/

          (
            cd "$workdir"
            git add -A
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              git commit -m "docs: publish canonical Antora site"
              git push origin HEAD:gh-pages --force
            else
              echo "No site changes to publish."
            fi
          )

          git worktree remove "$workdir" --force || true

name: quality-atlas-assessment

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      component:
        description: 'Optional component_id to assess (for example: documentating)'
        required: false
        type: string
      mode:
        description: 'Optional run mode override'
        required: false
        type: choice
        options:
          - auto
          - dry-run
          - responses
        default: auto
  schedule:
    - cron: '27 9 */2 * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: quality-atlas-assessment
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  assess:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout master
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: master
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install pyyaml

      - name: Seed current component snapshots
        run: |
          python3 tools/seed_quality_atlas_snapshots.py

      - name: Select assessment targets
        id: selection
        env:
          QUALITY_ATLAS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QUALITY_ATLAS_REPO_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          INPUT_COMPONENT: ${{ github.event.inputs.component || '' }}
        run: |
          component_args=()
          if [ -n "${INPUT_COMPONENT}" ]; then
            component_args+=(--component "${INPUT_COMPONENT}")
          fi
          python3 tools/select_quality_atlas_targets.py --event-name "${{ github.event_name }}" "${component_args[@]}" --output .sync/quality-atlas/generated/selection-plan.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          plan = json.loads(Path('.sync/quality-atlas/generated/selection-plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          selected = plan.get('selected_components') or []
          import os
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
              fh.write(f"selected_csv={','.join(selected)}\n")
              fh.write(f"selected_count={len(selected)}\n")
              fh.write(f"should_assess={'true' if selected else 'false'}\n")
              fh.write(f"selection_status={plan.get('status', 'unknown')}\n")
              requested = plan.get('manual_components') or []
              fh.write(f"requested_csv={','.join(requested)}\n")
          print(json.dumps({'selected_components': selected, 'selected_count': len(selected), 'status': plan.get('status')}, indent=2))
          PY

      - name: Run scheduled assessment dry-run or AI-backed pass
        id: assessment
        if: steps.selection.outputs.should_assess == 'true'
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          QUALITY_ATLAS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QUALITY_ATLAS_REPO_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          QUALITY_ATLAS_OPENAI_MODEL: ${{ vars.QUALITY_ATLAS_OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-5' }}
          INPUT_MODE: ${{ github.event.inputs.mode || 'auto' }}
          SELECTED_CSV: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.selected_csv }}
          REQUESTED_CSV: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.requested_csv }}
        run: |
          mode="dry-run"
          if [ "${INPUT_MODE}" = "responses" ]; then
            mode="responses"
          elif [ "${INPUT_MODE}" = "dry-run" ]; then
            mode="dry-run"
          elif [ -n "${OPENAI_API_KEY}" ]; then
            mode="responses"
          fi

          component_args=()
          IFS=',' read -ra selected <<< "${SELECTED_CSV}"
          selected_component="ALL_ENABLED"
          if [ -n "${REQUESTED_CSV}" ]; then
            selected_component="${REQUESTED_CSV}"
          elif [ -n "${SELECTED_CSV}" ]; then
            selected_component="${SELECTED_CSV}"
          fi
          for component in "${selected[@]}"; do
            if [ -n "${component}" ]; then
